t: A two-core STM32 chip that speaks Bluetooth, Thread, Zigbee, and Matter.
steps: Buy a P-NUCLEO-WB55 pack from the ST eStore, DigiKey or Future Electronics for about 50 to 76 US dollars.
Check that the radio core has ST's Bluetooth stack loaded. Flash it with ST's update tool before any Bluetooth code.
Download the MicroPython firmware for the NUCLEO_WB55 board and flash it.
Install the free Thonny editor and connect to the board over USB.
Run a script that blinks one of the three user LEDs.
Try a MicroPython Bluetooth example and find the board in a phone app.
Move to the Arduino IDE with STM32duinoBLE for Arduino sketches.
Try a WeAct STM32WB55 Core Board later as a cheap second board.
meta: Open Board. From $19.95. A few stores.
